description: This file defines the 'StackedColumn' class, which models a stacked column component used in reports, handling its properties such as name and child columns, and enabling conversion to an array representation.

classes.name: StackedColumn
classes.description: Represents a stacked column in the reporting system, containing child columns and a name, with methods for managing children and outputting as an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stacked column with an array of child columns.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the stacked column.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the array of child columns.

methods.name: setChildren
methods.description: Sets the array of child columns, adding each with addChild.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a single Column object to the children array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the stacked column and its children into an array form.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child columns.
